::: {.callout-note}
## Learn to prioritize passive acoustic data gaps

1. Choose a passive acoustic dataset to compare Current State baselines with Future State targets.
2. Review absolute variance, percentage improvement, and color-coded status for analyst review backlogs, AI pre-screening accuracy, and delivery delays.
3. Use the walkthrough to decide which shortfalls could delay marine mammal stock assessment delivery timelines.
4. When you are ready, [open the interactive workspace](./gap-primary.qmd) to analyze your own exports.
:::

## Explore three passive acoustic gap-analysis scenarios

These NOAA Fisheries Passive Acoustics Research Program examples compare Current and Future State targets for passive acoustic datasets. They use the same calculation as the workspace for lower-is-better measures such as lead time, process time, and hold rates:

$$\text{Improvement (\%)} = \frac{\text{Baseline} - \text{Target}}{|\text{Baseline}|} \times 100$$

For a higher-is-better measure such as first-pass %C&A accuracy, the subtraction is reversed. A negative result is a critical warning because the proposed target is worse than the baseline.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof gap_example_tutorial = {
  const gap_example_scenarios = {
    moorings: {
      label: "Long-Term Bottom-Mounted Moorings (e.g., HARP / PAMGuard)",
      summary:
        "A high-volume continuous recording pipeline where automated cloud ingest and AI pre-screening reduce analyst review backlogs.",
      observation:
        "Analyst Review Process Time represents the largest operational bottleneck. While First-Pass Accuracy improves significantly with AI pre-screening, hard drive ingest lead time requires immediate infrastructure scheduling to prevent data queuing.",
      rows: [
        ["Analyst Validation", "Process time", 6.5, 1.2, "hr / TB", "lower"],
        ["AI Detection", "First-pass accuracy (%C&A)", 78, 92, "%", "higher"],
        ["Drive Ingestion", "Ingest lead time", 14, 18, "days", "lower"]
      ]
    },
    gliders: {
      label: "Autonomous Mobile Gliders & AUVs",
      summary:
        "An autonomous glider workflow targeting automated timestamp-telemetry synchronization and streamlined scientific product generation.",
      observation:
        "GPS/Telemetry clock drift synchronization causes the primary delay. Automating log parsing eliminates a 5-day lead time bottleneck and dramatically reduces sync errors.",
      rows: [
        ["Telemetry Sync", "Sync lead time", 5.0, 0.5, "days", "lower"],
        ["Clock Alignment", "Sync error rate", 14, 1, "%", "lower"],
        ["Product Review", "Scientist sign-off time", 3.0, 1.5, "days", "lower"]
      ]
    },
    towed_arrays: {
      label: "Towed Hydrophone Survey Arrays",
      summary:
        "A vessel survey pipeline aiming to accelerate post-cruise 3D call localization and minimize vessel noise QA/QC holds.",
      observation:
        "Manual bearing verification is the primary operational constraint. Deploying automated localization algorithms reduces verification time from 3.5 to 0.8 hours per hour of audio, resolving tracking holds before stock report entry.",
      rows: [
        ["Bearing Verification", "Process time", 3.5, 0.8, "hr / hr audio", "lower"],
        ["Track QA/QC", "Tracking hold rate", 15, 2, "%", "lower"],
        ["Report Entry", "NetCDF export lead time", 4.0, 1.0, "days", "lower"]
      ]
    }
  };

  const gap_example_root = document.createElement("div");
  gap_example_root.className = "gap-example-tutorial";

  const gap_example_control = document.createElement("div");
  gap_example_control.className = "gap-example-control";
  const gap_example_label = document.createElement("label");
  gap_example_label.htmlFor = "gap-example-scenario";
  gap_example_label.textContent = "Passive acoustic dataset";
  const gap_example_select = document.createElement("select");
  gap_example_select.id = "gap-example-scenario";
  for (const [gap_example_key, gap_example_scenario] of Object.entries(
    gap_example_scenarios
  )) {
    const gap_example_option = document.createElement("option");
    gap_example_option.value = gap_example_key;
    gap_example_option.textContent = gap_example_scenario.label;
    gap_example_select.append(gap_example_option);
  }
  const gap_example_status = document.createElement("span");
  gap_example_status.className = "gap-example-status";
  gap_example_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  gap_example_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  gap_example_control.append(
    gap_example_label,
    gap_example_select,
    gap_example_status
  );

  const gap_example_content = document.createElement("div");
  gap_example_root.append(gap_example_control, gap_example_content);

  function gap_example_format(gap_example_value) {
    return Number(gap_example_value.toFixed(1)).toString();
  }

  function gap_example_calculate(gap_example_row) {
    const [
      gap_example_node,
      gap_example_metric,
      gap_example_baseline,
      gap_example_target,
      gap_example_unit,
      gap_example_direction
    ] = gap_example_row;
    const gap_example_delta = gap_example_target - gap_example_baseline;
    const gap_example_improvement = gap_example_baseline === 0
      ? null
      : (gap_example_direction === "higher"
          ? gap_example_target - gap_example_baseline
          : gap_example_baseline - gap_example_target) /
        Math.abs(gap_example_baseline) * 100;
    const gap_example_status_value = gap_example_improvement === null
      ? ["uncalculated", "⚪ Not calculated"]
      : gap_example_improvement >= 20
        ? ["target", "🟢 On Target"]
        : gap_example_improvement >= 0
          ? ["moderate", "🟡 Moderate Gap"]
          : ["critical", "🔴 Critical Gap"];
    return {
      node: gap_example_node,
      metric: gap_example_metric,
      baseline: `${gap_example_format(gap_example_baseline)} ${gap_example_unit}`,
      target: `${gap_example_format(gap_example_target)} ${gap_example_unit}`,
      delta: `${gap_example_delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}${gap_example_format(gap_example_delta)} ${gap_example_unit}`,
      improvement:
        gap_example_improvement === null
          ? "Not calculated"
          : `${gap_example_format(gap_example_improvement)}%`,
      status_key: gap_example_status_value[0],
      status_label: gap_example_status_value[1]
    };
  }

  function gap_example_render() {
    const gap_example_scenario =
      gap_example_scenarios[gap_example_select.value];
    const gap_example_panel = document.createElement("section");
    gap_example_panel.className = "gap-example-panel";
    const gap_example_heading = document.createElement("h3");
    gap_example_heading.textContent = gap_example_scenario.label;
    const gap_example_summary = document.createElement("p");
    gap_example_summary.textContent = gap_example_scenario.summary;

    const gap_example_table_wrap = document.createElement("div");
    gap_example_table_wrap.className = "gap-example-table-wrap";
    const gap_example_table = document.createElement("table");
    gap_example_table.className = "gap-example-table";
    const gap_example_caption = document.createElement("caption");
    gap_example_caption.textContent =
      `${gap_example_scenario.label} passive acoustic dataset variance breakdown`;
    const gap_example_head = document.createElement("thead");
    const gap_example_head_row = document.createElement("tr");
    [
      "Process node",
      "Metric",
      "Baseline",
      "Target",
      "Absolute variance (Δ)",
      "Improvement",
      "Gap status"
    ].forEach((gap_example_heading_text) => {
      const gap_example_header = document.createElement("th");
      gap_example_header.scope = "col";
      gap_example_header.textContent = gap_example_heading_text;
      gap_example_head_row.append(gap_example_header);
    });
    gap_example_head.append(gap_example_head_row);
    const gap_example_body = document.createElement("tbody");

    gap_example_scenario.rows
      .map(gap_example_calculate)
      .forEach((gap_example_result) => {
        const gap_example_table_row = document.createElement("tr");
        gap_example_table_row.dataset.status = gap_example_result.status_key;
        [
          gap_example_result.node,
          gap_example_result.metric,
          gap_example_result.baseline,
          gap_example_result.target,
          gap_example_result.delta,
          gap_example_result.improvement,
          gap_example_result.status_label
        ].forEach((gap_example_value) => {
          const gap_example_cell = document.createElement("td");
          gap_example_cell.textContent = gap_example_value;
          gap_example_table_row.append(gap_example_cell);
        });
        gap_example_body.append(gap_example_table_row);
      });

    gap_example_table.append(
      gap_example_caption,
      gap_example_head,
      gap_example_body
    );
    gap_example_table_wrap.append(gap_example_table);

    const gap_example_legend = document.createElement("p");
    gap_example_legend.className = "gap-example-legend";
    ["🟢 20% or greater", "🟡 0% to under 20%", "🔴 Negative improvement"].forEach(
      (gap_example_legend_text) => {
        const gap_example_legend_item = document.createElement("span");
        gap_example_legend_item.textContent = gap_example_legend_text;
        gap_example_legend.append(gap_example_legend_item);
      }
    );
    const gap_example_observation = document.createElement("p");
    gap_example_observation.className = "gap-example-observation";
    gap_example_observation.textContent = gap_example_scenario.observation;

    gap_example_panel.append(
      gap_example_heading,
      gap_example_summary,
      gap_example_table_wrap,
      gap_example_legend,
      gap_example_observation
    );
    gap_example_content.replaceChildren(gap_example_panel);
    gap_example_status.textContent =
      `Showing ${gap_example_scenario.label}.`;
  }

  gap_example_select.addEventListener("change", gap_example_render);
  gap_example_render();
  return gap_example_root;
}
```

## Analysis walkthrough

::: {.callout-tip}
## 1. Confirm comparable measures

Check that baseline and target values use the same passive acoustic dataset boundary, definition, and unit. A convincing percentage is not useful if one value measures analyst review hours and the other measures days.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 2. Check the direction of improvement

For passive acoustic datasets, lead times, process times, and hold rates improve when they decrease. First-pass %C&A accuracy improves when it increases. The workspace assumes lower is better, so edit its calculated percentage and status when adding a higher-is-better custom measure.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## 3. Intervene on critical gaps first

A red row means the proposed Future State is worse than the baseline, such as the mooring drive-ingest target. Verify the source data and target, then resolve the regression before creating a Kaizen experiment. Next, review yellow rows and large analyst review backlogs whose success depends on untested assumptions, constrained staff, or unavailable technology.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 4. Turn a verified gap into an experiment

Choose a gap with a clear owner, measurable baseline, and testable target that protects marine mammal stock assessment delivery timelines. Preserve the evidence and export `gap-analysis.csv`; it will seed the later Kaizen Experiments workspace.
:::

## Analyze your own process

Import your latest Current and Future State passive acoustic dataset CSV files, review calculated rows, and add any measures that were not captured in the maps. Your browser will prompt you to download `gap-analysis.csv`; save or move it into `output/`.
